name: B10-0183/2025 (ECR) – Unlawful detention and sham trials of Armenian hostages, including high-ranking political representatives from Nagorno-Karabakh, by Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the unlawful detention and sham trials of Armenian hostages, including high-ranking political representatives from Nagorno-Karabakh, by Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Union to put pressure on Azerbaijan over Armenians held there. It wants international human rights observers let into the trials, a mission to watch the court cases, and future EU money and cooperation tied to real human rights progress. It also offers legal and technical help for fair trials. The text is a request and a statement of opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It asks the EU to act and offers support for fair trials.
- **Who it affects:** Armenian prisoners and former Nagorno-Karabakh leaders on trial in Azerbaijan.
- **What happens next:** The request goes to EU bodies and to the governments of Azerbaijan and Armenia.
